item.title: Africa-made climate models required for better forecasts, early warning and attribution
item.description: Experts stress the need for Africa-specific climate models to improve forecasts and early warnings. Current models fail to capture regional nuances, as seen in recent southern African floods. Locally developed models could better predict and attribute extreme weather, aiding vulnerable communities.

item.title: Tackling air pollution could deliver $220 billion economic boost for India, study finds
item.description: India could gain $220 billion by 2030 through clean air measures, reducing PM2.5 levels by 20% and creating 1.4 million jobs. The report highlights clean air as an economic opportunity, urging it to be a development priority.

item.title: Economic Survey 2026: Capital, land & grid hurdles need to be tackled to sustain India’s renewable energy momentum
item.description: The Economic Survey 2025-26 emphasizes addressing capital costs, land delays, and grid constraints to sustain India's renewable energy growth, alongside battery storage and digital reforms for a transformed electricity sector.

item.title: Economic Survey 2025-26 suggests congestion pricing for dense business districts
item.description: The Economic Survey 2025-26 recommends congestion pricing in India's busiest cities to reduce traffic and emissions, citing successful examples from London and Singapore.

item.title: Economic Survey 2026: Agriculture grows 4.6%, powered by livestock and fisheries, not crops
item.description: The Economic Survey 2026 reveals a 4.6% growth in agriculture, driven by livestock and fisheries, not crops. Despite favorable monsoons, crop growth remains volatile, highlighting structural issues. Livestock and fisheries have become key growth engines, but face challenges due to feed shortages.
